items.heading: Confusion After 12th Feels Personal
items.text: Confusion after 12th feels personal. It is not.

items.heading: Psychologists Call This General Pattern
items.text: Psychologists call this general pattern choice overload or the paradox of choice. When people face too many options, they do not become more confident. They become more anxious, more prone to freezing, and more likely to regret whatever they eventually pick.
